presets.name: multicanalita
presets.description: Config equivalente a send-monitor-tpp-messages. Compilare i valori vuoti in base all'ambiente target.

athena.query:
WITH interesting_timelines AS (
  SELECT
    timelineElementId,
    date_trunc( 'hour', at_timezone(from_iso8601_timestamp(timestamp), 'Europe/Rome')) as ora_invio
  FROM
    pn_timelines_json_view
  WHERE
    timelineElementId LIKE '%TPP%'
    AND CONCAT(p_year, p_month, p_day, p_hour) >= '{{startYear}}{{startMonth}}{{startDay}}{{startHour}}'
    AND CONCAT(p_year, p_month, p_day, p_hour) <= '{{endYear}}{{endMonth}}{{endDay}}{{endHour}}'
)
SELECT
  ora_invio,
  count(*) as notifiche_tpp
FROM
  interesting_timelines
GROUP BY
  ora_invio
ORDER BY
  ora_invio

rules: name=tpp-messages-threshold;field=notifiche_tpp;operator=>;value=100;aggregation=any-row;severity=warning;message=Rilevate fasce orarie con notifiche TPP sopra soglia

athena.query:
WITH trackings AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.trackingId
      ORDER BY t.updatedAt DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM "pn_paper_trackings_json_view" t
  WHERE p_year = '{{startYear}}'
    AND p_month = '{{startMonth}}'
    AND p_day = '{{startDay}}'
),
errors AS (
  SELECT e.*
  FROM "pn_paper_trackings_errors_json_view" e
  WHERE p_year = '{{startYear}}'
    AND p_month = '{{startMonth}}'
    AND p_day = '{{startDay}}'
),
latest_trackings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM trackings
  WHERE rn = 1
),
errors_with_trackings AS (
  SELECT
    latest_trackings.*,
    errors.category AS errorCategory,
    errors.productType AS errorProductType
  FROM errors
  LEFT JOIN latest_trackings
    ON latest_trackings.trackingId = errors.trackingId
  WHERE errors.type = 'ERROR'
)
SELECT
  errorProductType AS prodotto,
  errorCategory,
  unifiedDeliveryDriver AS recapitista,
  COUNT(*) AS numero_errori
FROM errors_with_trackings
GROUP BY errorProductType, errorCategory, unifiedDeliveryDriver
ORDER BY numero_errori DESC;

presets.name: critical-notification-monitoring
presets.description: Monitoraggio eventi CON080 di notifiche critiche.

athena.query: WITH local_time AS ( SELECT CAST(current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Rome' AS timestamp) AS now ), target_window AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN extract(hour FROM now) >= 17 THEN date_trunc('day', now) + INTERVAL '12' HOUR WHEN day_of_week(now) = 1 THEN date_trunc('day', now) - INTERVAL '3' DAY + INTERVAL '17' HOUR ELSE date_trunc('day', now) - INTERVAL '1' DAY + INTERVAL '17' HOUR END AS start_time, CASE WHEN extract(hour FROM now) >= 17 THEN date_trunc('day', now) + INTERVAL '17' HOUR ELSE date_trunc('day', now) + INTERVAL '12' HOUR END AS end_time FROM local_time ), hours_sequence AS ( SELECT h.hour_ts FROM target_window CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sequence(start_time, end_time - INTERVAL '1' HOUR, INTERVAL '1' HOUR)) AS h(hour_ts) ), partition_filters AS ( SELECT format('%04d', extract(year FROM hour_ts)) AS p_year, format('%02d', extract(month FROM hour_ts)) AS p_month, format('%02d', extract(day FROM hour_ts)) AS p_day, format('%02d', extract(hour FROM hour_ts)) AS p_hour FROM hours_sequence ) SELECT requestId, codiceOggetto, recapitista, cap, paId, timestamp FROM critical_monitoring_notification t JOIN partition_filters f ON t.year = f.p_year AND t.month = f.p_month AND t.day = f.p_day AND t.hour = f.p_hour;
